name: Immune globulin
executiveSummary: Human IVIG. Replacement: **0.4–0.8 g/kg** every 3–4 weeks. Immunomodulation (Kawasaki, GBS, many): **2 g/kg** total. ITP: **0.8–1 g/kg**. Slow initial infusion; anaphylaxis/headache/thrombosis risk.
indications:
## Indications

- Humoral immunodeficiency (replacement).
- Kawasaki, ITP, Guillain-Barré, CIDP, myasthenia, autoimmune encephalitis, MIS-C, etc.

## Precautions

- Do not mix with other IV drugs. Start slow (**0.3–0.5 mL/kg/h**) up to brand ceiling (**~4 mL/kg/h**).
- Caution in IgA deficiency, renal failure, thrombophilia, heart failure (volume overload).
- Brands not interchangeable without judgment.

> Institutional / immunology request often required.

adulto.dose: Replacement: **0.4–0.8 g/kg** IV every 3–4 weeks. ITP: **0.8–1 g/kg** (may repeat at 48 h). Kawasaki/GBS/CIDP load: **2 g/kg** total (1 dose or over 2–5 days). Myasthenia: often **1–2 g/kg**.
adulto.administration: IV only as labeled; do not mix with other drugs. Follow brand rate template.
adulto.notes: Premedicate per protocol if prior reactions.

pediatrico.dose: Immunodeficiency: **0.4–0.8 g/kg** every 3–4 weeks. Kawasaki / MIS-C: **2 g/kg** single dose (MIS-C usual max **100 g**). GBS/CIDP/encephalitis: **2 g/kg** over 2–5 days. ITP: **0.8–1 g/kg**. Myasthenia: **1 g/kg**.
pediatrico.administration: IV; start 0.3–0.5 mL/kg/h → up to 4 mL/kg/h.

stability:
## Stability

- Store 2–30 °C by brand. Discard leftover once opened.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Headache, fever, chills, nausea, myalgias; anaphylaxis; thrombosis; AKI (historical sucrose); volume overload.
